service.description: Starts the task number sequence of a project (Project_KEY, which TaskServices.create#Task numbers its tasks KEY-n from, a bank of 1 so there are no gaps) after lastTaskNum, so the first new task is lastTaskNum + 1. A project whose sequence is already started (an existing project, or a key used before) keeps it. In its own transaction: a sequence refill reads the row on another connection and would wait on an uncommitted insert.

The projects the current user may see, as what a find of projects, tasks, requests or time applies as a condition (no entity filter covers WorkEffort, Request or TimeEntry): - allProjects: true for the ADMIN group, which sees every project; the lists below then do not limit a find. - visibleProjectIds: the projects the user holds a current WorkEffortParty role on (memberProjectIds), and the projects with visibility All users or General (WevAllUsers, WevGeneral) of the user's organizations (orgIds: the filterOrgIds of PartyServices.get#PartyOrganizationInfo, the active organization when one is set): owned by one (ownerPartyId) or with one in a current role (as the Vendor). A project in Work group, Restricted or Confidential, or with no visibility, is seen only by its parties. - managedProjectIds: those the user is ProjectManager or Manager of, and restrictedItemIds: the Restricted and Confidential tasks the user holds a current role on. A Restricted or Confidential task is seen only by its own parties and the managers of its project. So a find of projects applies workEffortId in visibleProjectIds; a find of tasks applies rootWorkEffortId in visibleProjectIds and (visibilityEnumId not in WevRestricted, WevConfidential, or rootWorkEffortId in managedProjectIds, or workEffortId in restrictedItemIds); each unless allProjects. Four small finds, so a screen may call it on each render.
Sets a project's own value of a setting (a WorkEffortSettingType); an empty value removes the project's row, so the organization's applies again (get#ProjectSettings).

A project's settings by WorkEffortSettingType: its own WorkEffortSetting rows, else the organization's. The organization is organizationPartyId, else the project's owner when an organization, else its current Vendor. Its setting is the PartySetting the type's optionValue names (a Projects app setting, ProjBillingDefaults and the like), a JSON object whose enumCode key holds the value (a boolean as Y or N); a type without an optionValue has no organization default. An app setting that is not a JSON object is logged and skipped. settingSources tells for each value where it came from: project or organization.

actions.script:
const D = (value) => toDecimal(value ?? 0) const hundred = toDecimal(100) const zero = toDecimal(0) const we = workEffort const actualClientCost = D(we.actualClientCost) const totalClientCostAllowed = D(we.totalClientCostAllowed) const remainingWorkTime = D(we.remainingWorkTime) const actualWorkTime = D(we.actualWorkTime) const totalTimeAllowed = D(we.totalTimeAllowed) const hasEstimate = we.estimatedWorkTime != null && !D(we.estimatedWorkTime).isZero()
actualProfit = actualClientCost.subtract(D(we.actualCost)) clientBudgetRemaining = totalClientCostAllowed.subtract(actualClientCost) clientBudgetUsedPercent = totalClientCostAllowed.isZero() ? zero : actualClientCost.divide(totalClientCostAllowed).multiply(hundred) clientActualOverBudget = actualClientCost.compare(totalClientCostAllowed) > 0 && !totalClientCostAllowed.isZero()
actualPlusRemainingTime = actualWorkTime.add(remainingWorkTime) bestTimeEstimate = (we.estimatedWorkTime == null || actualPlusRemainingTime.compare(we.estimatedWorkTime) > 0) ? actualPlusRemainingTime : we.estimatedWorkTime estimatedCompletePercent = hasEstimate ? actualWorkTime.divide(we.estimatedWorkTime).multiply(hundred) : zero estimatedRemainingPercent = hasEstimate ? remainingWorkTime.divide(we.estimatedWorkTime).multiply(hundred) : zero estimatedActualPlusRemainingDiff = D(we.estimatedWorkTime).subtract(actualPlusRemainingTime) actualPlusRemainingOverEstimated = actualPlusRemainingTime.compare(D(we.estimatedWorkTime)) > 0
timeBudgetCompletePercent = totalTimeAllowed.isZero() ? zero : actualWorkTime.divide(totalTimeAllowed).multiply(hundred) timeBudgetRemainingPercent = totalTimeAllowed.isZero() ? zero : remainingWorkTime.divide(totalTimeAllowed).multiply(hundred) timeBudgetActualPlusRemainingDiff = totalTimeAllowed.subtract(actualPlusRemainingTime) actualPlusRemainingOverTimeBudget = actualPlusRemainingTime.compare(totalTimeAllowed) > 0
clientAverageHourCost = actualWorkTime.isZero() ? zero : actualClientCost.divide(actualWorkTime) clientEstimatedCost = clientAverageHourCost.multiply(bestTimeEstimate) clientBudgetEstimateDiff = totalClientCostAllowed.subtract(clientEstimatedCost)
estimatedCompleteBudgetPercentGap = estimatedCompletePercent.subtract(clientBudgetUsedPercent) estimatedCompleteOverBudget = estimatedCompletePercent.compare(clientBudgetUsedPercent) < 0
projectDanger = clientActualOverBudget || actualPlusRemainingOverEstimated projectWarning = estimatedCompleteOverBudget

service.description: Work items (WetTask) as the work item tree shows them (design-projects.md §5 "The work item tree", style-guide §3.15), one level per call (impl-projects.md F13), each row with its subtree's roll-up: - parentWorkEffortId: its children; topLevel with rootWorkEffortId: the project's items with no parent; or workEffortIds (a list or comma text): those items, and with withAncestors each one's ancestors up to the top (first, from the top down), so the matches of a find sit in their place. - A level is in rank order (sequenceNum, then the number of the key); statusId (comma list) narrows it. - Each row has the work effort's fields, childCount (its children the user sees), depth (0 at the top) and the roll-up of itself and its descendants, cancelled items and their subtrees left out (as get#WorkEffortChildStats sums them): totalEstimatedWorkTime, totalRemainingWorkTime, totalActualWorkTime, totalBudget (the totalTimeAllowed of the subtree), totalEstimatedPoints, itemCount and doneCount (descendants, and those Complete or Closed), percentDone (estimate less remaining over estimate, 0 to 100, null with no estimate). - totals: the same sums over the rows returned that are not an ancestor added for them. Only items the user may see (get#VisibleProjectInfo, impl-projects.md F1): of a project the user sees, a Restricted or Confidential one only for its parties and the project's managers; an item of no project for its owner and parties. Items of a project are read once per project, so the roll-ups of a level cost one find of the project.

service.description: A status update of a project (design-projects.md §4 ProjectOverview PostUpdate, §15 Project health): the message, a CommunicationEvent of type StatusUpdate from the user on the project's Chatter (WorkEffortCommEvent); the WorkEffortUpdate row with the health, the percent complete and whether it is posted for the client; and the project's healthEnumId, which follows the latest update. The project's internal members with a user, not the one posting, are told on the topic ProjectStatusUpdate (the client contacts are left to client access, impl-projects.md P10); a notification that fails is logged, not the update's.

What moved in a project (design-projects.md §15 Project activity), newest first and paged: the status changes of the project and its work items from the entity audit log, the comments, messages and status updates on them (WorkEffortCommEvent), and the commits linked to its items (WorkEffortGitCommit). A Restricted or Confidential item is left out unless the user is one of its parties or manages the project (get#VisibleProjectInfo). Each source stands alone: one that fails is logged, named in failedSources and left out. The caller checks that the user may see the project. An entry is {kind (status, comment, update or commit), date, workEffortId and workEffortName (the item, or the project), title (what changed, in words), text (a comment's start, a commit's summary), authorName, userId, communicationEventId or commitId}.

parameter.name: kinds
parameter.description: A comma list of status, comment, update, commit; empty is all

service.description: The counters of Projects Home for the current user (design-projects.md §3 Home Counters, §15 Project home and Today services), over the projects the user sees (get#VisibleProjectInfo; template projects left out): - myOpen: the open work items the user is an Assignee of; dueWeek: those due from today through seven days; overdue: those due before today (as WorkItems' smart lists mine, week and overdue); - reviewsWaiting: the open merge requests of the repositories the user may view where the user is a requested reviewer who has not reviewed yet (org.moqui.impl.GitReviewServices.find#MergeRequests waitingForUserId); null when the build has no git hosting; - hoursWeek: the hours of the user's time entries this week (the timesheet's status comes with timesheets); - with managers: projectsAtRisk, the open projects the user manages (ADMIN: all) whose health is At risk or Off track or whose numbers warn (get#ProjectStats projectWarning or projectDanger), and milestonesSoon, their open milestones due in fourteen days. The counters that need records of later phases (timesheetsToApprove, allocationRequests, unbilledAmount) are null until those phases. Each counter is computed on its own: one that fails is logged, named in failedParts and left null.

The project templates (design-projects.md §12 Templates, §15 Template flag: WorkEffort isTemplate Y) by name, each with its counts: work items, milestones, members (current WorkEffortParty rows) and the projects made from it (WorkEffortAssoc WeatBasedOn, which clone#Project writes). Those of organizationPartyId (its owner, or a current party of it) when given, and those with no owner.

A project template (design-projects.md §12 Templates NewTemplate, §4 ProjectSettings TemplateBox): a copy of baseWorkEffortId kept as a template (clone#Project with isTemplate Y: its tree, members, settings and files, the dates cleared and the items back in planning), or with no base a blank one (create#Project, isTemplate Y). The template has the base's owner, else ownerPartyId.
